description: A comprehensive refactor of the Sanity CMS to implement Smart Studio capabilities (Presentation Mode, Custom Desk Structure) while ensuring robust backup and automated migration to prevent data loss. Includes the deprecation of the 'skill' document type.

stories.title: Phase 1: Data Backup and Download
stories.description: Backup current production data down to local `/studio/data_downloads/` preventing any data loss before schema mutation.

stories.title: Phase 2: Schema Refactoring
stories.description: Rebuild schema architectures removing deprecated types (e.g. `skill`) while preparing new fields for Presentation integration and improved UX.

stories.title: Phase 3: Automated Migrations
stories.description: Develop and run scripts to transform old local backed-up `.ndjson` data into the new robust schema format without manual data entry.

stories.title: Phase 4: Smart Studio Setup
stories.description: Implement Presentation plugin, visual editing mappings, and streamline the desk structure for an advanced editor experience.
